note: Bench values a scale and calipers give, all taken on the ASSEMBLED rig (nothing is disconnected). Centres of mass and inertias are NOT measured.
added_mass_note: about 10 g (e.g. two M6 nuts), weighed on a 0.1 g kitchen scale, taped on the pendulum centre line
added_mass_d_note: pivot axis (608 centre) to the centre of the added mass, measured with calipers, +-0.5 mm. d1 for identification, d2 for validation. Keep d well away from g/omega^2 (about 66 mm), where adding mass does not change the swing frequency.
r_note: motor axis to the 608 centre, from the CAD (printed, +-0.2 mm); only used to report the hinge-offset combination
m_pendulum_note: OPTIONAL: only if the pendulum (with coin, magnet, 608 inner ring) was weighed before assembly. Needed only to turn G into a centre-of-mass distance. Set to null if not available.
